# pattern-recommendation

A skill for suggesting implementation patterns and anti-patterns.

Policy bindings
- Apply `.github/instructions/universal-structured-response.instructions.md`.
- Use scoped terms from `.github/response-dictionary.md`.
- Ask narrowing questions first when scope is broad.
- Default to short mode and compact evidence.

Focus
- Rust idioms, error handling, async flows, resource management, and GPU-specific patterns.
- Avoiding common mistakes while promoting code clarity and performance.

Output
- Scoped pattern recommendations and usage guidelines for the project.
